text:
sam_sales: Partner asked for a one-paragraph summary of our incident response commitments, who issues notices, and how it ties to SIG/CAIQ. Need copy I can paste.

ashley_security: One-paragraph draft: Redwoodmaintains a documented incident response program with 24/7 SOC monitoring, forensic capabilities, and a commitment to provide an initial factual acknowledgement within 72 hours of a confirmed incident. For Hosted customers Redwood coordinates and issues external notifications per contractual terms; for VPC/on-prem customers the customer leads external disclosures while Redwood provides forensic evidence and technical support. We map our IR controls to SIG/CAIQ and can provide a scoped extract for IR controls for evaluation; fuller SIG packages are available under controlled sharing.

sam_sales: Nice. Can you also give two short bullets I can paste into the SOW about notification timing and evidence handling?

ashley_security: Bullets:
- Notification timing: initial factual acknowledgement within 72 hours of incident confirmation; follow-up updates as investigations validate new facts.
- Evidence handling: Hosted 
Redwood supplies investigation artifacts to customers via secure transfer; for VPC customers we coordinate secure evidence delivery to the customer's SOC/forensics team.

matt_legal: Add legal guardrails before sending externally: 1) 72-hour metric refers to confirmed incidents only; 2) include non-liability and factual-only language; 3) copy legal@redwood.com on any external share of SIG/forensics materials.

lee_ps: Offer for POC: include a complimentary SIG IR extract and optional paid tabletop/runbook review (typical PS band $12k-$35k).

ir_bot: Generated IR reference: IR-2026-2209 (internal).

sam_sales: Perfect, sending now. Will loop legal if they want the full SIG. :rocket:
